Name: WORLD_MAP_POINT_PARAM_ST
Description: A point on the world map: a pin with an icon and up to 8 texts (place or NPC names). Rows are also the targets of MSB map-point regions (entering one sets the area name and the BGM) and of the event command that opens a map point.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build.

Fields.Name: Unlock Event Flag
Fields.Description: The pin is shown only while this flag is on; the game turns it on when the point is discovered (its linked point record is marked found). 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Display Condition Event Flag
Fields.Description: The pin is shown only while this flag is also on (retail: Night Boss Interference flags 8077-8080, day flag 7502...). 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Hide Event Flag
Fields.Description: The pin is hidden while this flag is on (retail 6011, 8062, 7518...). 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Linked Map Point ID
Fields.Description: ID of the map's point record this pin belongs to. When that record exists, its icon overrides and flags are used for the pin; when it is marked found, Event Flag ID 0 is turned on. Below 0 (or 0): none.

Fields.Name: World Map Point Icon ID
Fields.Description: Main icon of the pin: a WorldMapPointIconParam row (1 Grace, 16 Field Boss...). Only the low 16 bits are the icon; the high 16 bits are read as a second pin icon (0 on every retail row). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Display Mask M00
Fields.Description: The point appears on the surface world map (M00).

Fields.Name: Show on Underground Map (M01)
Fields.Description: The point appears on the underground map (M01).

Fields.Name: Distant View Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown instead of Icon ID while the point is open only through its Distant View event flag (its Open flag is still off).

Fields.Name: Map Area
Fields.Description: AA part of the map tile mAA_BB_CC_00 that the position is relative to. Retail 60 on every row.

Fields.Name: Map Block X
Fields.Description: BB part of the map tile that the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Block Z
Fields.Description: CC part of the map tile that the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Coordinate: X
Fields.Description: X position of the pin, relative to the map tile.

Fields.Name: Map Coordinate: Y
Fields.Description: Y (height) position of the pin, relative to the map tile.

Fields.Name: Map Coordinate: Z
Fields.Description: Z position of the pin, relative to the map tile.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 1
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 40802-40808 on 8 rows (the same detail icon IDs as SmallBaseAndSpotDefine).

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 2
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 40803-40807 on 4 rows.

Fields.Name: Sub Icon 1 - Icon ID
Fields.Description: Extra icon added to the pin (same IDs as World Map Point Icon ID), paired with Event Flag ID 2 as its condition. 0: none. Retail 1, 60 or 205 on some rows.

Fields.Name: Sub Icon 2 - Icon ID
Fields.Description: Second extra icon on the pin (same IDs as World Map Point Icon ID), paired with Event Flag ID 3 as its condition. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Sub Icon 1 - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Condition flag of Sub Icon 1. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Sub Icon 2 - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Condition flag of Sub Icon 2. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Area Icon Event Flag
Fields.Description: The pin's area icon is shown only while this flag is on. 0: always shown.

Fields.Name: Variation Icon ID
Fields.Description: Variation icon of the pin (same IDs as SmallBaseMapVariationParam Variation Icon ID, retail 42605/42608 on 2 rows). A placed site's variation icon replaces it. 0: none.

Fields.Name: State Icon 1 - Flag
Fields.Description: Option passed with State Icon 1 when the pin has no linked point record. Its effect is not established. Retail set on 24 rows.

Fields.Name: State Icon 2 - Flag
Fields.Description: Option passed with State Icon 2 when the pin has no linked point record. Its effect is not established. Retail: never set.

Fields.Name: State Icon 1 - Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon added to the pin's second icon list together with Event Flag ID 6 (both must be set); the linked point record can replace it. 0: none. Retail 72, 40 or 41 on 54 rows.

Fields.Name: State Icon 2 - Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon added to the pin's second icon list together with Event Flag ID 7 (both must be set); the linked point record can replace it. 0: none. Retail 30 on 3 rows.

Fields.Name: State Icon 1 - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Condition flag of State Icon 1 (both must be set for the icon to show). 0: none.

Fields.Name: State Icon 2 - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Condition flag of State Icon 2 (both must be set for the icon to show). 0: none.
Passed to the pin with its icons; replaced by the linked point record's value when there is one. Its effect is not established. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Sub Icon 3 - Icon ID
Fields.Description: Third extra icon on the pin (same IDs as World Map Point Icon ID), paired with the event flag that follows as its condition. 0: none. Retail 1 on two rows.

Fields.Name: Missing Event Flag
Fields.Description: While this flag is on the point counts as missing. In one game mode the game turns it on for every point when the map points are unlocked. 0: none. Retail: paired with the unlock flag (73100 -> 73910).

Fields.Name: Sub Icon 3 - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Condition flag for Sub Icon 3. Retail set on two rows.
